record.question: What is the equivalent rank of Wing Commander of IAF in the Indian Army?
record.explanation: Answer C: Lieutenant Colonel. The Air Force Regulations table of relative ranks places Wing Commander opposite Navy Commander and Army Lieutenant Colonel. Thus Lieutenant Colonel is the Army equivalent; Colonel corresponds to Group Captain. Reference: https://upload.indiacode.nic.in/showfile?actid=AC_CEN_28_38_00018_195045_1517807325980&filename=AFRegulations.pdf&type=regulation. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
